title: Implement recursive file discovery and multi-level restructuring
body:
This PR transitions Sortify from a flat data model to a hierarchical one, enabling deep directory organization and recursive file analysis. Previously, the system treated subdirectories as indivisible blocks, which prevented the AI from organizing files located deep within a folder structure or creating nested output directories.

### Why these changes are necessary
To support enterprise-scale document management, the system needs to "see" every file regardless of its current depth. By moving to a recursive scanning and clustering model, we allow the AI to suggest more sophisticated filing systems (e.g., `Year > Project Name > File Type`) rather than just a single level of folders.

### Key Changes

#### 1. Recursive File Discovery (`ui/app.py`)
Replaced the shallow, one-level file discovery process with `_get_files_recursively`. 
- **Rationale:** This ensures that no data is left behind during the scanning phase, allowing the AI to redistribute files buried deep in legacy "Archive" folders.

#### 2. Multi-Pass Hierarchical Clustering (`core/analyzer.py`)
The `IncrementalAnalyzer` now performs a recursive subset fit using `MiniBatchNMF`.
- **Logic:** If a generated cluster contains 3 or more files, the analyzer attempts to further sub-categorize those files. 
- **Guardrails:** We have enforced a limit of 12 clusters per level and a maximum depth of 5 levels to prevent overly fragmented directory trees and maintain AI performance.

#### 3. Nested Data Model & UI Treeview (`ui/app.py`)
Updated the "Sorting Plan" state from a flat array to a multi-level nested dictionary.
- **UI Improvements:** The CustomTkinter interface now uses `Treeview` logic to visualize the proposed structure. Users can expand and collapse nested folders to preview the organization before committing to the move.

#### 4. Recursive Move Engine & Cleanup (`core/mover.py`)
Refactored `execute_moves` to navigate the new nested dictionary structure.
- **Safety:** The engine now handles file relocation from deep source paths to new destination hierarchies and includes a post-move cleanup iteration to safely purge empty source subdirectories.

### Success Metrics
- Successfully extracts and redistributes files from 3+ levels deep.
- Sorting plan preview correctly displays expandable parent-child folder relationships.
- Prevents data loss during movement by validating file transfers before directory cleanup.
